description: UROC1 tissue restriction: liver dominance, absence from brain and skin
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
rows=[]; page=0
while True:
    r=requests.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
        params={"gencodeId":"ENSG00000159650.8","datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100,"page":page},
        headers=H, timeout=90).json()
    rows+=r["data"]
    if page>=r["paging_info"]["numberOfPages"]-1: break
    page+=1
g=pd.DataFrame(rows).rename(columns={"tissueSiteDetailId":"tissue"})[["tissue","median"]].sort_values("median",ascending=False)
print(g[g.tissue.str.contains("Skin|Kidney|Liver|Esophagus|Small_Intestine|Colon",case=False)].to_string(index=False))
brain=g[g.tissue.str.startswith("Brain")]
liver=g.loc[g.tissue=="Liver","median"].iloc[0]
print("\nLiver/brain-mean fold = %.0f ; Liver/2nd-highest-tissue fold = %.0f"%(liver/brain["median"].mean(), liver/g["median"].iloc[1]))

top=g.head(15).iloc[::-1]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5.4),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.25,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.barh(top.tissue.str.replace("_"," "), top["median"],
        color=["#b4553a" if t=="Liver" else "#5b6b7c" for t in top.tissue])
for i,v in enumerate(top["median"]): ax.text(v+1.2,i,f"{v:.2f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("median TPM, GTEx v8"); ax.set_title("UROC1 is a liver gene (94.1% of summed median TPM)")

ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(["liver","mean of 13\nbrain regions","skin\n(sun exposed)"],
       [liver, brain["median"].mean(), g.loc[g.tissue=="Skin_Sun_Exposed_Lower_leg","median"].iloc[0]],
       color=["#b4553a","#5b6b7c","#5b6b7c"], width=0.55)
ax.set_yscale("log"); ax.set_ylabel("median TPM (log scale)")
for i,v in enumerate([liver, brain["median"].mean(), g.loc[g.tissue=="Skin_Sun_Exposed_Lower_leg","median"].iloc[0]]):
    ax.text(i, v*1.3, f"{v:.3f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Urocanase is absent from brain and skin\nso urocanate is a normal end-product in those tissues")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
